-- Add folder_id to quiz_bank_questions
ALTER TABLE quiz_bank_questions ADD COLUMN folder_id INT NULL;

-- Create quiz_bank_folders table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quiz_bank_folders (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id INT NOT NULL,
  bank_id INT NOT NULL,
  parent_id INT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  color VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT '#24abbc',
  sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- Add missing columns to quizzes table (new schema columns)
ALTER TABLE quizzes 
  ADD COLUMN randomize_questions TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN randomize_answers TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN feedback_mode ENUM('immediate','end','never') DEFAULT 'end' NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN show_explanations TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN allow_partial_credit TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN penalty_for_wrong TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN pass_score_percent INT DEFAULT 70 NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN publish_domain VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN publish_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN cover_image_url VARCHAR(1024) NULL;
